def test_get_closest_vowel():
    # Returns the rightmost qualifying vowel
    assert get_closest_vowel("abidef") == "e"
    assert get_closest_vowel("yogurt") == "u"

    # Supports uppercase vowels
    assert get_closest_vowel("bAcEd") == "E"

    # Adjacent vowels do not qualify
    assert get_closest_vowel("boat") == ""

    # Vowels at the beginning or end do not qualify
    assert get_closest_vowel("abc") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("bca") == ""

    # Words shorter than three characters
    assert get_closest_vowel("") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("a") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("at") == ""

    # No vowels
    assert get_closest_vowel("rhythm") == ""
